descriptionChirho: The proper masculine name Abram (Hebrew אַבְרָם), the original name of the patriarch Abraham before God renamed him (Genesis 17:5). All 61 occurrences refer to the same individual with only prepositional/conjunctional variation. Multilingual translations are fully consistent: eng 'Abram', spa 'Abram/Avram', hin अव्रम, arb أَبْرَام, kor 아브람, swa 'Abramu'. The prepositional form (S79838 'in Abram') is a syntactic variant, not a distinct sense.
